shortDescription: Manage switchports on a switch in the Meraki cloud

options.name: access_policy_number
options.description: Number of the access policy to apply. Only applicable to access port types.

options.name: access_policy_type
options.description: Type of access policy to apply to port.

options.name: allowed_vlans
options.description: List of VLAN numbers to be allowed on switchport.

options.name: auth_key
options.description: Authentication key provided by the dashboard. Required if environmental variable C(MERAKI_KEY) is not set.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether a switchport should be enabled or disabled.

options.name: flexible_stacking_enabled
options.description: Whether flexible stacking capabilities are supported on the port.

options.name: host
options.description: Hostname for Meraki dashboard. Can be used to access regional Meraki environments, such as China.

options.name: internal_error_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if server returns an internal server error.

options.name: isolation_enabled
options.description: Isolation status of switchport.

options.name: link_negotiation
options.description: Link speed for the switchport.

options.name: mac_allow_list
options.description: MAC addresses list that are allowed on a port. Only applicable to access port type. Only applicable to access_policy_type "MAC allow list".

options.name: name
options.description: Switchport description.

options.name: number
options.description: Port number.

options.name: org_id
options.description: ID of organization.

options.name: org_name
options.description: Name of organization.

options.name: output_format
options.description: Instructs module whether response keys should be snake case (ex. C(net_id)) or camel case (ex. C(netId)).

options.name: output_level
options.description: Set amount of debug output during module execution.

options.name: poe_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable Power Over Ethernet on a port.

options.name: rate_limit_retry_time
options.description: Number of seconds to retry if rate limiter is triggered.

options.name: rstp_enabled
options.description: Enable or disable Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol on a port.

options.name: serial
options.description: Serial nubmer of the switch.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies whether a switchport should be queried or modified.

options.name: sticky_mac_allow_list
options.description: MAC addresses list that are allowed on a port. Only applicable to access port type. Only applicable to access_policy_type "Sticky MAC allow list".

options.name: sticky_mac_allow_list_limit
options.description: The number of MAC addresses allowed in the sticky port allow list. Only applicable to access port type. Only applicable to access_policy_type "Sticky MAC allow list". The value must be equal to or greater then the list size of sticky_mac_allow_list. Value will be checked for validity, during processing.

options.name: stp_guard
options.description: Set state of STP guard.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags to assign to a port.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time to timeout for HTTP requests.

options.name: type
options.description: Set port type.

options.name: use_https
options.description: If C(no), it will use HTTP. Otherwise it will use HTTPS. Only useful for internal Meraki developers.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate HTTP certificates.

options.name: vlan
options.description: VLAN number assigned to port. If a port is of type trunk, the specified VLAN is the native VLAN. Setting value to 0 on a trunk will clear the VLAN.

options.name: voice_vlan
options.description: VLAN number assigned to a port for voice traffic. Only applicable to access port type. Only applicable if voice_vlan_state is set to present.

options.name: voice_vlan_state
options.description: Specifies whether voice vlan configuration should be present or absent.
